access_policy.evaluator_custody: host_for_complete_gold; official evaluator where benchmark supplies it
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: offline companion has no public-answer search path; live companion logs benchmark exposure and is secondary

exclusion_policy: Unavailable routes are censored observations, never imputed zero reward; transport failures remain recorded. No run is removed for low yield or failed exploration.
plots: P2V2-2 safety credit and route allocation over time

primary_hypothesis.text: On complete-gold retrieval under the same total search budget, adaptive conservative censored allocation reduces normalized search cost by at least 10% at a frozen recall target while final recall is non-inferior within 1 percentage point and premature task closure is not worse by more than 1 percentage point.

resource_policy: V1 and V2 receive identical total query/tool/token/time budgets and the same route set; the safe baseline route is included as an available action for V2.

secondary_hypotheses.text: Treating unavailable providers as censored rather than zero reward improves route allocation calibration.
Earned route independence prevents duplicated-backend exploration from receiving unsafe novelty credit.

statistics.interval: 95% paired bootstrap difference plus Wilson intervals for closure rates
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across secondary inferential comparisons
